✨ Clean Up Your Phone and Free Up Space Easily

Is your phone storage full again? Reclaim gigabytes of space in under 60 seconds. Photos and videos can quickly take up valuable space — but Cleanup makes it simple to organize and optimize your device safely.

With smart tools for photo cleanup and video compression, you can reclaim storage in just a few taps.

🧹 Smart Cleaning and Storage Optimization

Cleanup is an all-in-one phone cleaner that helps you keep your device organized without losing what matters.

It analyzes your storage, finds unnecessary clutter, and helps you free up space intelligently.

📸 Focus on What Matters – Clean Duplicate Photos

No more scrolling through endless galleries. Cleanup automatically detects and removes duplicate and similar photos in seconds.

Its smart AI selects the best shots, so you can clear your gallery safely and keep only the photos you truly want.

With Cleanup, you can:

✅ Instantly detect and delete duplicate photos
🔍 Identify and remove similar screenshots and lookalike videos
🗜️ Compress large videos while keeping high quality
🚀 Enjoy more available storage space and smoother performance

👆 Swipe to Keep or Delete

Manage your photos, videos, and files easily with a simple swipe.

Choose what stays and what goes to maintain an organized phone that’s clear, simple, and clutter-free.

🎥 Video Compression Made Simple

Running low on storage because of large videos?

Cleanup’s video compressor reduces file sizes without sacrificing quality — saving gigabytes of space while preserving your favorite moments.

🛡️ Safe, Smart, and Easy to Use

Cleanup is designed for everyone — simple, intuitive, and safe.

Enjoy a clean, organized phone and optimized storage without worrying about losing what’s important.

📱 Download Cleanup today and discover the easiest way to clean, organize, and optimize your phone.
